---
knit: (function(inputFile, encoding){rmarkdown::render(inputFile,encoding=encoding,output_dir="./resultats")})
output:
  pdf_document: 
    latex_engine: xelatex
    # includes:
    #   in_header:
    #     - "./templates/preambule.tex"
    pandoc_args: 
      - "--variable=geometry:top=1cm"
      - "--variable=geometry:bottom=1cm"
      - "--variable=geometry:left=2cm"
      - "--variable=geometry:right=2cm"
      - "--variable=geometry:headheight=2cm"
      - "--variable=geometry:footskip=1cm"
      - "--variable=geometry:marginparwidth=2cm"
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{graphicx}
  - \usepackage{eso-pic}
  - \usepackage{arabtex}
  - \usepackage{utf8}
  - \usepackage{xcolor} 
  - \definecolor{monOr}{HTML}{D4AF37} # Définition d'un joli doré royal
  - \newfontfamily\policevoeux{Calibri} 
  # - \newfontfamily\policenom{LaBelleAurore-Regular}[Path = fonts/La_Belle_Aurore/, Extension = .ttf]
  - \newfontfamily\policenom{Mynerve-Regular}[Path = fonts/Mynerve/, Extension = .ttf]
  

params:
  nom: "Destinataire" # Valeur par défaut
  titre: "Cher"
---
